title: Brutus-Pell Square-Rank Relation
description: An explicit Pell rank-of-apparition family derived from classical prime-power lifting and coprime rank composition. The note isolates z_P(21^k)=4*21^(k-1) for k>=2 and the square-rank subfamily z_P(21^(2r+1))=(2*21^r)^2. The general Lucas-sequence lifting machinery is classical; this record does not claim novelty for the general theorem.
